candidates.name: Yanmar Holdings
candidates.description: Both are major global manufacturers of construction, industrial, and agricultural machinery with a focus on engine technology.
candidates.rationale: Yanmar manufactures engines and construction, agricultural, and industrial machinery, overlapping Caterpillar’s core equipment offerings and buyers.

candidates.name: Komatsu America Corp
candidates.description: Both are direct global competitors in the manufacturing of heavy equipment for mining, construction, and forestry industries.
candidates.rationale: Komatsu directly competes with Caterpillar in heavy construction, mining, and forestry equipment for the same industrial buyers and applications.

candidates.name: Deere & Company
candidates.description: Both provide extensive portfolios of heavy machinery for agriculture, construction, and earthmoving applications.
candidates.rationale: Deere manufactures construction and earthmoving machinery overlapping Caterpillar’s core equipment portfolio for the same industrial buyers and applications.

candidates.name: Volvo Construction Equipment
candidates.description: Both manufacture a comprehensive range of heavy-duty construction and earthmoving equipment for global markets.
candidates.rationale: Both manufacture heavy construction and earthmoving machinery evaluated by the same contractors, fleet operators, and industrial equipment buyers.

candidates.name: Hitachi Construction Machinery Co.
candidates.description: Both companies specialize in high-end hydraulic excavators and heavy mining and construction machinery.
candidates.rationale: Both manufacture heavy construction and mining equipment, including hydraulic excavators, for the same industrial buyers and applications.

candidates.name: Liebherr Group
candidates.description: Both are major international manufacturers of heavy construction equipment, cranes, and specialized mining machines.
candidates.rationale: Liebherr directly overlaps Caterpillar in heavy construction and mining equipment, serving the same industrial fleet owners, contractors, and equipment buyers.

candidates.name: JCB, Inc.
candidates.description: Both offer extensive lines of earthmoving equipment, including backhoe loaders, excavators, and construction site machinery.
candidates.rationale: JCB manufactures overlapping construction and earthmoving machinery for the same contractors, fleet operators, and equipment buyers as Caterpillar.

candidates.name: SANY Group
candidates.description: Both operate as large-scale multinational manufacturers of heavy construction equipment, concrete machinery, and cranes.
candidates.rationale: SANY manufactures heavy construction machinery, including excavators, cranes, and concrete equipment, serving the same industrial buyers and jobs as Caterpillar.

candidates.name: CASE Construction Equipment
candidates.description: Both provide a full range of high-performance construction and earthmoving equipment for professional contractors.
candidates.rationale: CASE manufactures construction and earthmoving equipment for the same professional contractors who evaluate Caterpillar machinery.

candidates.name: Bobcat Company
candidates.description: Both produce compact equipment used in construction and site preparation, with strong market positions in site-work machinery.
candidates.rationale: Bobcat manufactures compact construction and site-preparation equipment, directly overlapping Caterpillar’s machinery offerings and serving the same equipment buyers.

candidates.name: Wirtgen Group
candidates.description: Both manufacture specialized equipment for road construction, paving, and surface mining operations.
candidates.rationale: Wirtgen manufactures heavy road-construction and surface-mining machinery, directly overlapping Caterpillar’s equipment offerings and serving the same industrial buyers.

candidates.name: Zoomlion Heavy Industry Science & Technology Co.
candidates.description: Both are large industrial conglomerates focused on heavy machinery for construction, mining, and agricultural use.
candidates.rationale: Zoomlion manufactures heavy construction, mining, and agricultural machinery, overlapping Caterpillar’s core equipment offerings and serving the same industrial buyers.

candidates.name: Manitou Group
candidates.description: Both specialize in material handling, lifting, and earthmoving solutions for the construction and industrial sectors.
candidates.rationale: Manitou manufactures material-handling, lifting, and earthmoving equipment for the same construction and industrial buyers served by Caterpillar.

candidates.name: Kubota Tractor
candidates.description: Both produce a range of construction equipment and heavy machinery alongside agricultural and utility product lines.
candidates.rationale: Kubota manufactures construction and heavy equipment that overlaps Caterpillar’s core machinery offerings and targets many of the same commercial equipment buyers.

candidates.name: Epiroc Group
candidates.description: Both are critical partners for the mining and infrastructure industries, providing heavy equipment for drilling and excavation.
candidates.rationale: Epiroc manufactures drilling and excavation equipment for mining and infrastructure, directly overlapping Caterpillar’s heavy-equipment offerings and industrial buyers.

candidates.name: Tatahitachi
candidates.description: Both produce heavy construction equipment including excavators and dump trucks for the global infrastructure market.
candidates.rationale: Tata Hitachi manufactures excavators and other heavy construction equipment for the same infrastructure and construction buyers as Caterpillar.

candidates.name: Xcmg America
candidates.description: Both are significant manufacturers of heavy construction machinery including earthmoving equipment and cranes.
candidates.rationale: XCMG manufactures heavy construction equipment, directly overlapping Caterpillar’s machinery offerings for construction and industrial buyers.

candidates.name: Bemlindia
candidates.description: Both manufacture heavy equipment for the mining and construction sectors in addition to specialized transport vehicles.
candidates.rationale: BEML manufactures heavy construction and mining equipment, overlapping Caterpillar’s core machinery offerings and serving the same industrial buyers.

candidates.name: Astec Industries, Inc.
candidates.description: Both provide heavy machinery solutions for infrastructure development, specifically in aggregate, asphalt, and concrete production.
candidates.rationale: Astec manufactures heavy equipment for construction, aggregates, asphalt, and concrete, overlapping Caterpillar’s machinery offerings and infrastructure-industry buyers.

candidates.name: Poclain Hydraulics PVT LTD
candidates.description: Both develop core hydraulic power transmission components for off-road machinery and construction equipment.
candidates.rationale: Poclain supplies hydraulic components to equipment OEMs, while Caterpillar primarily sells complete heavy machinery; buyers would not evaluate them for the same job.

candidates.name: New Holland Ag
candidates.description: Both offer a dual focus on heavy agricultural machinery and specialized construction equipment.
candidates.rationale: New Holland manufactures construction equipment overlapping Caterpillar’s machinery portfolio, serving contractors and equipment buyers with similar earthmoving and jobsite needs.

candidates.name: Husqvarna AB
candidates.description: Both companies manufacture professional-grade equipment and tools for the construction and demolition sectors.
candidates.rationale: Both manufacture professional construction equipment, with overlapping contractor buyers and machinery needs in construction and demolition.

candidates.name: Metso
candidates.description: Both provide equipment and end-to-end solutions for the aggregates, mining, and construction industries.
candidates.rationale: Metso manufactures mining, aggregates, and construction equipment, overlapping Caterpillar’s core machinery offerings and serving the same industrial buyers.

candidates.name: Sandvik AB
candidates.description: Both serve the mining and rock excavation sectors with high-end, heavy-duty mechanical engineering solutions.
candidates.rationale: Sandvik manufactures mining, rock-excavation, and heavy industrial equipment evaluated by many of the same buyers as Caterpillar’s mining machinery.

candidates.name: FPT Industrial S.p.A.
candidates.description: Both design and manufacture heavy-duty industrial engines and powertrains tailored for off-road construction and earthmoving vehicles.
candidates.rationale: FPT Industrial overlaps Caterpillar’s core industrial-engine and powertrain business, serving manufacturers and operators of construction and earthmoving equipment.
